post.summary:
lncli: `createoffer`
CreateOffer creates a new BOLT 12 offer. The offer is persisted in the
offer store and the encoded offer string (lno1...) is returned. The node
must run with --protocol.bolt12-offers.

get.summary:
lncli: `decodeoffer`
DecodeOffer takes a bech32-encoded BOLT 12 offer string (lno1...) and
returns the decoded fields. This is a stateless utility analogous to
DecodePayReq for BOLT 11. The node must run with
--protocol.bolt12-offers.

post.summary:
lncli: `importgraph`
ImportGraph imports a ChannelGraph into the graph database. Should only be
used for development.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Returns a new instance of the directed channel graph.

post.summary:
lncli: `payoffer`
PayOffer takes a BOLT 12 offer string, negotiates an invoice with the
offer's issuer via onion message, validates the returned invoice, and
dispatches an HTLC to complete the payment. Returns a stream of updates:
invoice_request_sent, invoice_received, and payment_result. The node
must run with --protocol.bolt12-offers.

Quiesce instructs a channel to initiate the quiescence (stfu) protocol. This
RPC is for testing purposes only. The commit that adds it will be removed
once interop is confirmed.

lncli: `requestinvoice`
RequestInvoice takes a BOLT 12 offer string, constructs and signs an
invoice request, sends it to the offer's issuer via onion message,
waits for the invoice reply, validates it, and returns the decoded
BOLT 12 invoice. No payment is dispatched. The node must run with
--protocol.bolt12-offers.

description.description:
A UTF-8 description of the purpose of the payment. Required when
amount_msat is set.

amount_msat.description:
The amount expected per item in millisatoshis. Zero or unset means
the payer chooses the amount.

absolute_expiry.description:
Seconds since epoch after which the offer expires. Zero or unset
means no expiry.

quantity_max.description:
Maximum number of items that can be requested in a single invoice.
Zero means unlimited. If not set, quantity selection is not
supported.

use_blinded_paths.description:
When true, the offer uses blinded message paths (offer_paths) instead
of revealing the node's identity via offer_issuer_id. This provides
receiver privacy. The payer cannot learn the receiver's node pubkey
from the offer.

offer_hash.description: The 32-byte offer hash: the SHA256 of the offer's TLV records.

amount_msat.description: The amount per item in millisatoshis. Zero if the payer chooses.

issuer.description: The offer issuer's free-form name or identifier.

The 33-byte compressed pubkey of the offer issuer. Empty when
offer_paths is used instead.

offer_paths.description:
Blinded paths for reaching the offer issuer when
offer_issuer_id is absent.

features.description: The raw feature bits advertised by the offer.

chains.description:
The chains this offer is valid for, as hex-encoded 32-byte
chain hashes. Empty implies bitcoin only.

currency.description:
The currency for offer_amount (e.g. "USD"). Empty means the
amount is denominated in the chain's native unit (msat for
bitcoin).

invoice_payment_hash.description: The 32-byte payment hash from the invoice.

amount_msat.description: The amount being requested in millisatoshis.

idempotency_key.description:
The idempotency key of this payment. A retry with the same key
returns this payment instead of paying again.

invreq_payer_id.description:
The 33-byte compressed ephemeral payer pubkey from the
invoice request.

offer.description: The decoded offer fields from the invoice for convenience.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key of this payment.

amount_msat.description:
The amount in millisatoshis. Required when the offer does not
specify a fixed amount.

quantity.description:
The number of items to request. Required when the offer
supports quantity selection.

payer_note.description: An optional payer note included in the invoice request.

timeout_seconds.description:
Timeout in seconds to wait for the invoice reply during
negotiation. Defaults to 60 if unset or zero.

fee_limit_msat.description:
Maximum fee in millisatoshis to pay for routing. If zero, a
default percentage of the payment amount is used.

idempotency_key.description:
The caller's idempotency key for this payment. A call with a key
that already has a payment returns that payment instead of paying
again, and a key used with other parameters is refused. If empty,
the node generates a random key and reports it in the updates.

blinded_node.description: The blinded public key of the node.

encrypted_data.description: An encrypted blob of data provided to the blinded node.

introduction_node.description: The unblinded pubkey of the introduction node for the route.

blinding_point.description: The ephemeral pubkey used by nodes in the blinded route.

blinded_hops.description:
A set of blinded node keys and data blobs for the blinded portion of the
route. Note that the first hop is expected to be the introduction node,
so the route is always expected to have at least one hop.

node_sig1.description:
node_sig1 are the raw bytes of the first node signature encoded
in DER format.

bitcoin_sig1.description:
bitcoin_sig1 are the raw bytes of the first bitcoin signature of the
MultiSigKey key of the channel encoded in DER format.

node_sig2.description:
node_sig2 are the raw bytes of the second node signature encoded
in DER format.

bitcoin_sig2.description:
bitcoin_sig2 are the raw bytes of the second bitcoin signature of the
MultiSigKey key of the channel encoded in DER format.

lnrpcChannelAuthProof.description:
ChannelAuthProof is the authentication proof (the signature portion) for a
channel. Using the four signatures contained in the struct, and some
auxiliary knowledge (the funding script, node identities, and outpoint) nodes
on the network are able to validate the authenticity and existence of a
channel.

channel_id.description:
The unique channel ID for the channel. The first 3 bytes are the block
height, the next 3 the index within the block, and the last 2 bytes are the
output index for the channel.

auth_proof.description:
Authentication proof for this channel. This proof contains a set of
signatures binding four identities, which attests to the legitimacy of
the advertised channel. This only is available for advertised channels.
This field is not filled by default. Pass include_auth_proof flag to
DescribeGraph, GetNodeInfo or GetChanInfo to get this data.

lnrpcChannelEdge.description:
A fully authenticated channel along with all its unique attributes.
Once an authenticated channel announcement has been processed on the network,
then an instance of ChannelEdgeInfo encapsulating the channels attributes is
stored. The other portions relevant to routing policy of a channel are stored
within a ChannelEdgePolicy for each direction of the channel.

nodes.title: The list of `LightningNode`s in this channel graph

edges.title: The list of `ChannelEdge`s in this channel graph

lnrpcChannelGraph.description: Returns a new instance of the directed channel graph.

funding_txid_bytes.description:
Txid of the funding transaction. When using REST, this field must be
encoded as base64.

funding_txid_str.description:
Hex-encoded string representing the byte-reversed hash of the funding
transaction.

output_index.title: The index of the output of the funding transaction

lnrpcLightningNode.description:
An individual vertex/node within the channel graph. A node is
connected to other nodes by one or more channel edges emanating from it. As the
graph is directed, a node will also have an incoming edge attached to it for
each outgoing edge.

custom_records.description:
Custom channel update tlv records. These are customized fields that are
not defined by LND and cannot be extracted.
